WITH sex_avgs AS (
  SELECT p.SEX,
         AVG(e."aCL IgG") AS avg_igg,
         AVG(e.ANA) AS A
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(A) AS B
  FROM sex_avgs
)
SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_igg, s.A, s.A / b.B AS ratio
FROM sex_avgs AS s
CROSS JOIN b
WHERE b.B IS NOT NULL
